note: Scripture fragments are spliced byte-for-byte from Kulish (1905), parsed whole from the ebible mirror (ukr_pan); each row was checked mechanically as a verbatim substring of its Kulish verse and present in the bio. They sit inside Whitefield’s own quotations, so Kulish’s pre-1928 spelling (угождав, народити ся звиш) shows inside modern prose — a reviewer may prefer plain prose there.
Unquoted allusions (Song 3:11, Ps 112:6, 2 Tim 4:7) are rendered as prose and not listed.
“negroes” in Whitefield’s quoted letters is rendered «негрів» to keep the historical quotation faithful; flagged for native review of tone.
